fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the day you arrive in Myanmar.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses después del día de tu llegada a Myanmar.
entry.quote: your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas desde un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Myanmar, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Bringing more than 10,000 US dollars-worth of foreign currency requires declaring it to customs on arrival, or you risk imprisonment.
entry.es: Si traes más de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses en divisas, debes declararlo en la aduana al llegar o arriesgas prisión.
entry.quote: If you plan to bring more than 10,000 US dollars-worth of any foreign currency, you must declare this to customs on arrival or risk imprisonment.

entry.en: You cannot import gold or gold bullion into Myanmar for trading and risk arrest if you do.
entry.es: No puedes importar oro ni lingotes de oro a Myanmar para comerciar y arriesgas ser arrestado si lo haces.
entry.quote: You cannot import gold or gold bullion into Myanmar for trading and risk arrest for doing so.

entry.en: On arrival you must declare valuable articles, including gold, gems and jewellery, to customs.
entry.es: Al llegar debes declarar a la aduana los artículos de valor, incluidos oro, gemas y joyas.
entry.quote: declare any valuable articles including gold, gems and jewellery with customs.

entry.en: If you overstay your visa, you will be liable to pay a fine and could face detention.
entry.es: Si te quedas más tiempo del permitido por tu visa, tendrás que pagar una multa y podrías ser detenido.
entry.quote: If you overstay your visa, you will be liable to pay a fine and could face detention.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to border areas including Kachin, Chin, Kayah, Kayin, Rakhine, Shan State North, Sagaing and parts of Tanintharyi.
safety.es: FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a zonas fronterizas como los estados de Kachin, Chin, Kayah, Kayin, Rakhine, Shan Norte, la región de Sagaing y parte de Tanintharyi.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to the following border areas: Kachin State, Chin State, Kayah State, Kayin State, Sagaing Region, Rakhine State, Shan State North and Tanintharyi Region

safety.en: The Myanmar military took control by force in February 2021 and declared a state of emergency, leading to increased conflict.
safety.es: El ejército de Myanmar tomó el control por la fuerza en febrero de 2021 y declaró el estado de emergencia, lo que aumentó el conflicto.
safety.quote: In February 2021, the Myanmar military took control of the country by force and declared a state of emergency leading to increased conflict.

safety.en: The risk of landmines in rural areas is serious, particularly in northern and central Rakhine, northern Shan and Kachin states.
safety.es: El riesgo de minas terrestres en zonas rurales es grave, sobre todo en el norte y centro de Rakhine y en los estados de Shan norte y Kachin.
safety.quote: The risk of landmines in rural areas is serious, particularly in northern and central Rakhine, northern Shan and Kachin states.

safety.en: Thieves often distract victims by asking questions, begging, offering items for sale, or bumping or jostling them.
safety.es: Los ladrones suelen distraer a sus víctimas haciendo preguntas, mendigando, ofreciendo artículos en venta o empujándolas.
safety.quote: Thieves often distract their victims by asking questions, begging for money, offering items for sale, or simply bumping or jostling.

safety.en: Avoid all demonstrations, large crowds and political gatherings, and you risk arrest if you photograph protests.
safety.es: Evita todas las manifestaciones, multitudes y reuniones políticas, y arriesgas ser arrestado si fotografías protestas.
safety.quote: Be cautious and avoid all demonstrations, large crowds and political gatherings. You risk arrest and detention if you attempt to photograph demonstrations or protests.

safety.en: Be cautious of job offers in Myanmar and neighbouring countries that appear too good to be true.
safety.es: Desconfía de las ofertas de trabajo en Myanmar y países vecinos que parezcan demasiado buenas para ser ciertas.
safety.quote: Be cautious of job offers that appear too good to be true in Myanmar and neighbouring countries.

health.en: Never drink tap water; ordering ice is usually safe in major places because restaurants must use ice from bottled water companies.
health.es: Nunca bebas agua del grifo; pedir hielo suele ser seguro en lugares importantes porque los restaurantes deben usar hielo de empresas de agua embotellada.
health.quote: Never drink tap water. Restaurants are legally required to use ice made and sold by bottled water companies, so ordering ice is usually safe in major places.

health.en: Diseases such as dengue fever, Japanese encephalitis and malaria are endemic.
health.es: Enfermedades como el dengue, la encefalitis japonesa y la malaria son endémicas.
health.quote: Diseases such as dengue fever, Japanese encephalitis and malaria are endemic.

health.en: Hepatitis vaccinations are highly recommended and the cholera oral vaccine is worthwhile.
health.es: Se recomiendan mucho las vacunas contra la hepatitis y vale la pena la vacuna oral contra el cólera.
health.quote: Hepatitis vaccinations are highly recommended and the cholera oral vaccine is worthwhile.

health.en: You will usually need to make cash payments up front to get medical treatment in Myanmar.
health.es: Normalmente tendrás que pagar en efectivo por adelantado para recibir tratamiento médico en Myanmar.
health.quote: usually need to make cash payments up front to get medical treatment in Myanmar.

health.en: Pharmaceutical products for sale could be counterfeit.
health.es: Los productos farmacéuticos a la venta podrían ser falsificados.
health.quote: Pharmaceutical products for sale could be counterfeit.

health.en: You are unlikely to find competent medical advice and treatment easily outside Yangon and Mandalay.
health.es: Es poco probable que encuentres fácilmente atención médica competente fuera de Yangon y Mandalay.
health.quote: unlikely to find competent medical advice and treatment easily outside Yangon and Mandalay

help.en: Emergency numbers in Myanmar are ambulance 192, fire 191 and police 199.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Myanmar son ambulancia 192, bomberos 191 y policía 199.

getting_in.en: Myanmar's main international airport is at Yangon (RGN), the largest city and main economic centre.
getting_in.es: El principal aeropuerto internacional de Myanmar está en Yangon (RGN), la ciudad más grande y centro económico principal.
getting_in.quote: Myanmar's main international airport is located at Yangon (RGN IATA), the largest city and main economic centre.

getting_in.en: Mandalay (MDL) is a second international airport, served by several flights to neighbouring countries.
getting_in.es: Mandalay (MDL) es un segundo aeropuerto internacional, con varios vuelos a países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: Myanmar also has a second international airport at Mandalay (MDL IATA), which is served by several flights to the neighbouring countries.

getting_in.en: The easiest way to reach Myanmar from outside the region is a flight from Singapore or Bangkok.
getting_in.es: La forma más fácil de llegar a Myanmar desde fuera de la región es un vuelo desde Singapur o Bangkok.
getting_in.quote: the easiest way to get into Myanmar will be to catch a flight from either Singapore or Bangkok

getting_in.en: Due to the ongoing civil war, as of 2026 entering Myanmar by land varies from difficult to impossible.
getting_in.es: Debido a la guerra civil en curso, en 2026 entrar a Myanmar por tierra va de difícil a imposible.
getting_in.quote: due to the ongoing civil war, as of 2026 entering Myanmar by land varies from difficult to impossible.

getting_in.en: There are four Thai border crossings, and as of 2026 none are open to tourists.
getting_in.es: Hay cuatro pasos fronterizos con Tailandia y, a 2026, ninguno está abierto a turistas.
getting_in.quote: Four border crossings exist between Myanmar and Thailand at Tachileik/Mae Sai, Myawaddy/Mae Sot, Htee Kee/Ban Phunamron and the Three Pagoda Pass. As of 2026, none are open to tourists.

getting_in.en: Small wooden longtail boats shuttle between Ranong, Thailand and Kawthaung, Myanmar.
getting_in.es: Pequeños botes de madera de cola larga hacen el trayecto entre Ranong, Tailandia, y Kawthaung, Myanmar.
getting_in.quote: Small wooden longtail boats shuttle between Ranong, Thailand and Kawthaung, Myanmar.

getting_around.en: Travel between Mandalay, Bagan, Inle Lake and Yangon is fairly straightforward.
getting_around.es: Viajar entre Mandalay, Bagan, el lago Inle y Yangon es bastante sencillo.
getting_around.quote: travel between the main tourist sites, namely Mandalay, Bagan, Inle Lake and Yangon, is fairly straightforward.

getting_around.en: Because roads and railways are in poor state, flying is the least uncomfortable option for long distances.
getting_around.es: Como las carreteras y los ferrocarriles están en mal estado, volar es la opción menos incómoda para largas distancias.
getting_around.quote: The poor state of Myanmar's roads and railways make flying by far the least uncomfortable option when travelling long distances.

getting_around.en: In theory tourists can apply for permits to restricted areas, but in practice they are unlikely to be issued in reasonable time, or at all.
getting_around.es: En teoría los turistas pueden solicitar permisos para zonas restringidas, pero en la práctica es poco probable que se emitan en un plazo razonable, o nunca.
getting_around.quote: In theory, any tourist can apply for a permit to visit any restricted area or to travel on any restricted land route. In practice, it is unlikely that any such permit will be issued in a reasonable amount of time, or at all.

getting_around.en: Tourists cannot buy tickets on the train, and your passport is required when purchasing.
getting_around.es: Los turistas no pueden comprar boletos en el tren y se requiere el pasaporte al comprar.
getting_around.quote: but tourists cannot buy tickets on the train. At smaller stations, you may have to seek the stationmaster or use an interpreter to buy a ticket. Your passport is required when purchasing.

getting_around.en: Grab is the main ride-hailing app in Myanmar.
getting_around.es: Grab es la principal aplicación de transporte con conductor en Myanmar.
getting_around.quote: The main ride hailing app is Grab, which took over Uber's former South-east Asian operations, including that of Myanmar.

getting_around.en: Night-time road travel is not recommended and medical facilities are limited in rural areas.
getting_around.es: No se recomienda viajar de noche por carretera y los servicios médicos son limitados en zonas rurales.
getting_around.quote: Night-time road travel is not recommended, and medical facilities are limited in rural areas.

money.en: Myanmar's currency is the kyat, pronounced "chat".
money.es: La moneda de Myanmar es el kyat, que se pronuncia "chat".
money.quote: Myanmar's currency is the kyat, pronounced "chat".

money.en: Myanmar is largely a cash-based society and you should expect to rely on cash for most of your stay.
money.es: Myanmar es en gran parte una sociedad basada en efectivo y debes contar con usar efectivo durante casi toda tu estancia.
money.quote: Myanmar is largely a cash-based society. Expect to rely on cash for most of your stay.

money.en: Many ATMs do not accept UK or international bank cards and some banks limit daily withdrawals.
money.es: Muchos cajeros no aceptan tarjetas bancarias internacionales y algunos bancos limitan los retiros diarios.
money.quote: Many ATMs do not accept UK or international bank cards and some banks have limits on daily withdrawals.

money.en: Bring very clean, unfolded U.S. dollars or hotels, restaurants and money changers will not accept them.
money.es: Lleva dólares estadounidenses muy limpios y sin doblar, o los hoteles, restaurantes y casas de cambio no los aceptarán.
money.quote: Bring very clean, unfolded U.S. dollars (or they will not be accepted by hotels, restaurants and money changers).

money.en: Tipping is generally not practised by the Burmese, though tips are appreciated for exemplary service.
money.es: Los birmanos generalmente no dan propina, aunque se agradece por un servicio ejemplar.
money.quote: Tipping is generally not practised by the Burmese themselves. However, given widespread poverty in the country, tips are certainly appreciated if you have been provided with exemplary service.

money.en: Exchanging money on the black market is illegal, with sellers risking jail time and periodic crackdowns.
money.es: Cambiar dinero en el mercado negro es ilegal, los vendedores arriesgan cárcel y hay redadas periódicas.
money.quote: Exchanging on the black market is illegal: sellers risking jail time and the junta periodically cracks down.

etiquette.en: Modest clothing is highly appreciated everywhere except nightclubs and practically required in pagodas, temples and monasteries.
etiquette.es: Se aprecia mucho la ropa modesta en todas partes excepto en discotecas y es prácticamente obligatoria en pagodas, templos y monasterios.
etiquette.quote: Modest clothing is highly appreciated everywhere except nightclubs, and practically required in religious places such as pagodas, temples and monasteries

etiquette.en: You have to remove your footwear before entering the entire temple complex, including outdoor areas.
etiquette.es: Debes quitarte el calzado antes de entrar a todo el complejo del templo, incluidas las zonas al aire libre.
etiquette.quote: you have to remove your footwear before entering the entire temple complex, including in outdoor areas.

etiquette.en: Burmese people generally do not engage in public displays of affection, even among married couples, and it should be avoided.
etiquette.es: Los birmanos generalmente no muestran afecto en público, ni siquiera las parejas casadas, y conviene evitarlo.
etiquette.quote: Burmese people generally do not engage in public display of affection, even among married couples, and it is generally considered distasteful and should be avoided.

etiquette.en: Foreigners have been jailed for disrespecting Buddhism, so be careful about what you say and do.
etiquette.es: Se ha encarcelado a extranjeros por faltar al respeto al budismo, así que ten cuidado con lo que dices y haces.
etiquette.quote: Foreigners have been jailed for disrespecting Buddhism, so be careful about what you say and what you do.

etiquette.en: Always ask for permission before photographing or touching a monk.
etiquette.es: Pide siempre permiso antes de fotografiar o tocar a un monje.
etiquette.quote: Always ask for permission before taking a photograph or touching a monk.

etiquette.en: When giving and receiving business cards, use your right hand palm up with your left hand supporting your right elbow.
etiquette.es: Al dar y recibir tarjetas de presentación, usa la mano derecha con la palma hacia arriba y la izquierda sosteniendo el codo derecho.
etiquette.quote: When giving and receiving business cards, always use your right hand with the palm facing up, and your left hand supporting your right elbow.

connectivity.en: Foreign mobile phone SIM cards do not reliably work in Myanmar.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM extranjeras no funcionan de forma fiable en Myanmar.
connectivity.quote: Foreign mobile phone SIM cards do not reliably work in Myanmar.

connectivity.en: Visitors can buy a SIM card for a nominal fee when they arrive.
connectivity.es: Los visitantes pueden comprar una tarjeta SIM por una tarifa nominal al llegar.
connectivity.quote: Visitors can buy a SIM card for a nominal fee when they arrive.

connectivity.en: Some services, including Facebook and WhatsApp, are blocked and inaccessible without VPNs.
connectivity.es: Algunos servicios, como Facebook y WhatsApp, están bloqueados y son inaccesibles sin VPN.
connectivity.quote: Some services are blocked (including Facebook and WhatsApp) and are inaccessible without Virtual Private Networks (VPNs).

connectivity.en: The authorities control internet access and periodically cut it off entirely.
connectivity.es: Las autoridades controlan el acceso a internet y periódicamente lo cortan por completo.
connectivity.quote: the Myanmar authorities control internet access, and periodically cut off access entirely.

connectivity.en: For longer stays you must register your phone's IMEI or the device will be automatically blocked from local networks.
connectivity.es: En estancias largas debes registrar el IMEI de tu teléfono o el dispositivo será bloqueado automáticamente de las redes locales.
connectivity.quote: register your phone’s IMEI through the Central Equipment Identity Register’s (CEIR) Official Portal, otherwise, your device will be automatically blocked from local networks.

connectivity.en: You can buy GSM/4G SIM cards at international airports or any convenience store.
connectivity.es: Puedes comprar tarjetas SIM GSM/4G en aeropuertos internacionales o en cualquier tienda de conveniencia.
connectivity.quote: You can buy GSM/4G sim cards at International airports or any convenience store.
